flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (83.3% vs 3.8%): operating leverage
Operating margin up 500 bps over 3 years
Cash conversion strong: 5y operating cash = 171% of profit
Cash cycle tightened by 17 days in 2 years (33 → 16)

claims.claim: Consolidated revenues crossed Rs.51,100 crores, crossing Rs.50,000 crores for the first time.
claims.quote: Our consolidated revenues in Quarter 4 crossed Rs.51,100 crores, crossing Rs.50,000 crores for the first time.

claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA stood at Rs.9,713 crores with a 19% EBITDA margin for Q4.
claims.quote: Adjusted EBITDA stood at Rs.9,713 crores with an EBITDA margin of 19%, while PAT stood at Rs.19,243 crores.

claims.quote: We achieved 99% of our production guidance and 102% of our sales volume guidance for the year.

pushback.quote: So how confident are we in ramping up the captive mix from 1/3rd currently to 50%?
Is there a potential conflict in future? And I mean, a few years down the line, we have 3 large plants supplying flat steel from Odisha.
Because for -- in the near-term, I think your cash flows might not match, if I'm not mistaken.

calls.tone: Confident, optimistic, and strategic regarding long-term growth and balance sheet deleveraging.

claims.quote: our consolidated revenues during the Quarter 1 FY27 were Rs.47,364 crores. Adjusted EBITDA stood at Rs.9,373 crores with an EBITDA margin of 20%, while PAT stood at Rs.4,696 crores.

claims.quote: project SEED, our flagship decarbonisation project has delivered a cumulative emissions reduction of approximately 5 Mn tCO2 since 2022.

claims.quote: Utilisation of capacities for our Indian operations stood at approximately 94%, excluding the BF-3 which was under shutdown, much higher than the 88% in Quarter 1 last year.

claims.quote: The second tranche of JFE's equity investment of INR7,875 crores for JSW JV joint venture transaction has been received on 30th June, as scheduled.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed consolidated revenues crossed Rs.51,100 crores in Q4 FY26; Mar 2026 revenue was reported at Rs.51,180.0 crores.
Management stated Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin was 20%; reported June 2026 EBITDA margin matches at 20.0%.
Management claimed net debt leverage fell to 1.81x as of March 31, 2026, supported by borrowings of Rs.99,310.0 crores.

bull: Operating margin expanded with EBIT% rising to 15.1% in Jun 2026 and 14.5% in Sep 2026.
Strong 5-year operating cash conversion at 171% of profit with Mar 2026 OCF at Rs.25,152.0 crores.
Robust debt reduction seen in Sep 2026 with borrowings dropping to Rs.69,820.0 crores and D/E at 0.62.
bear: Borrowings increased significantly over prior years, reaching Rs.99,310.0 crores by Mar 2026 before dropping in Sep 2026.
Historical free cash flow volatility, including -3,469.0 crores in Mar 2024.
PAT showed sharp historical fluctuations, dropping to Rs.3,491.0 crores in Mar 2025 before rising to Rs.25,508.0 crores in Mar 2026.
watch: Full-year FY27 capex spend versus the Rs.22,000 to Rs.24,000 crores guidance.
Consolidated steel production and sales progress towards 29.75 Mt and 28.6 Mt targets.
